with cms_players as (
    select *
    from `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`stg_cms_players`
),

loyalty_members as (
    select *
    from `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`stg_loyalty_members`
),

joined_identities as (
    select
        -- Stable natural key resolved across systems
        coalesce(c.cms_player_id, l.member_no) as player_natural_key,
        c.cms_player_id,
        l.member_no,

        -- Conformed attributes (resolving overlaps via email PII)
        coalesce(c.email, l.email) as email,
        coalesce(c.first_name, l.first_name) as first_name,
        coalesce(c.last_name, l.last_name) as last_name,
        coalesce(c.dob, l.dob) as dob,

        -- Loyalty attributes
        l.tier as loyalty_tier,
        l.enroll_date,

        -- Source coverage tracking flags
        case when c.cms_player_id is not null then true else false end
            as has_casino_profile,
        case when l.member_no is not null then true else false end
            as has_loyalty_profile

    from cms_players c
    full outer join loyalty_members l
        on c.email = l.email
)

from joined_identities

        cms_player_id,
        rating_ts,
        game_type,
        coin_in,
        house_edge,
        _loaded_at
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`stg_cms_ratings`
),

identities AS (
    SELECT
        player_sk,
        cms_player_id
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`int_player_identity_map`
    WHERE cms_player_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(r.cms_player_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(r.rating_ts as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string)))
        AS sk_rating_id,
    i.player_sk,
    r.cms_player_id,
    r.game_type,
    r.coin_in,
    r.house_edge,
    (r.coin_in * r.house_edge) AS theoretical_win,
    r.rating_ts,
    r._loaded_at AS source_loaded_at
FROM ratings r
LEFT JOIN identities i

    ON r.cms_player_id = i.cms_player_id

with redemptions as (
    select
        campaign_id,
        member_no,
        redemption_ts,
        redemption_ts as redemption_date,
        offer_amount,
        _loaded_at as source_loaded_at
    from `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`stg_promo_redemptions`

    

    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by
            campaign_id, member_no, redemption_ts, offer_amount, _loaded_at
        order by campaign_id
    ) = 1
),

-- Sanitize and handle potential nulls cleanly before surrogate key generation
clean_redemptions as (
    select
        coalesce(campaign_id, 'UNKNOWN') as safe_campaign_id,
        coalesce(member_no, 'UNKNOWN') as safe_member_no,
        coalesce(cast(redemption_ts as string), '1900-01-01')
            as safe_redemption_ts,
        coalesce(cast(offer_amount as string), '0') as safe_offer_amount,
        coalesce(cast(source_loaded_at as string), '1900-01-01')
            as safe_loaded_at,
        redemption_date,
        offer_amount,
        source_loaded_at
    from redemptions
),

identities as (
    select
        player_sk,
        member_no,
        cms_player_id
    from `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`int_player_identity_map`
    where member_no is not null
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by member_no
        order by cms_player_id desc, player_sk
    ) = 1
)

select
    -- Clean, robust macro call using pre-sanitized column names
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(r.safe_campaign_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(r.safe_member_no as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(r.safe_redemption_ts as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(r.safe_offer_amount as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(r.safe_loaded_at as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string))) as sk_redemption_id,
    coalesce(i.player_sk, 'UNKNOWN_PLAYER') as player_sk,
    i.cms_player_id,
    r.safe_campaign_id as campaign_id,
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(r.safe_campaign_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string)))
        as sk_campaign_id,
    r.redemption_date,
    r.offer_amount,
    r.source_loaded_at
from clean_redemptions r
left join identities i
    on r.safe_member_no = i.member_no

with snapshots as (
    select *
    from `nwr-data-platform`.`snapshots`.`snp_players`
),

gaming_activity as (
    select
        cms_player_id,
        sum(coin_in) as lifetime_coin_in,
        count(1) as total_ratings_count
    from `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`stg_cms_ratings`
    group by 1
)

select
    -- 1. Entity-Level Lifetime Key (Repeats across historical rows for the same player)
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(snapshots.player_natural_key as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string))) as player_sk,

    -- 2. Row-Level Version Surrogate Key (100% UNIQUE per row/version)
    to_hex(md5(cast(coalesce(cast(snapshots.player_natural_key as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(snapshots.dbt_valid_from as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') as string))) as player_version_sk,

    snapshots.player_natural_key,
    snapshots.cms_player_id,
    snapshots.member_no,
    snapshots.first_name,
    snapshots.last_name,
    snapshots.email,
    snapshots.dob,
    snapshots.loyalty_tier,
    snapshots.enroll_date,

    -- SCD Type 2 Audit Columns
    snapshots.dbt_valid_from as valid_from,
    snapshots.dbt_valid_to as valid_to,
    case when snapshots.dbt_valid_to is null then true else false end as is_current,

    -- Aggregated Metrics
    coalesce(g.lifetime_coin_in, 0) as lifetime_coin_in,
    coalesce(g.total_ratings_count, 0) as total_ratings_count,

    -- Official Enterprise Segmentation Logic
    case
        when snapshots.cms_player_id is not null and coalesce(g.lifetime_coin_in, 0) > 0 then true
        else false
    end as is_gaming_active,

    case
        when snapshots.cms_player_id is not null and coalesce(g.lifetime_coin_in, 0) > 0 then 'Casino Active'
        else 'Hotel / Loyalty Only'
    end as guest_segment,

    current_timestamp() as _updated_at

from snapshots
left join gaming_activity g
    on snapshots.cms_player_id = g.cms_player_id

WITH daily_aggregate AS (
    SELECT
        player_sk,
        CAST(rating_ts AS DATE) AS play_date,
        SUM(coin_in) AS total_coin_in,
        SUM(theoretical_win) AS total_theoretical_win
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`fct_ratings`
    GROUP BY
        player_sk,
        CAST(rating_ts AS DATE)
),

player_dim AS (
    SELECT
        player_sk,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        loyalty_tier
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`dim_players`
    -- Safely ensure 1 row per player_sk in case dim_players holds multiple rows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY player_sk
        ORDER BY loyalty_tier DESC
    ) = 1
)

SELECT
    a.player_sk,
    a.play_date,
    d.first_name,
    d.last_name,
    d.loyalty_tier,
    a.total_coin_in,
    a.total_theoretical_win
FROM daily_aggregate a
LEFT JOIN player_dim d
    ON a.player_sk = d.player_sk

select player_sk
from `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_gold`.`mart_campaign_performance`
where player_sk is null

WITH silver_summary AS (
    SELECT
        campaign_id,
        SUM(offer_amount) AS silver_offer_amount
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_silver`.`fct_campaign_redemption`
    GROUP BY campaign_id
),

gold_summary AS (
    SELECT
        campaign_id,
        SUM(offer_amount) AS gold_offer_amount
    FROM `nwr-data-platform`.`dbt_erd_nwr_gold`.`mart_campaign_performance`
    GROUP BY campaign_id
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(s.campaign_id, g.campaign_id) AS campaign_id,
    s.silver_offer_amount,
    g.gold_offer_amount
FROM silver_summary AS s
FULL OUTER JOIN gold_summary AS g
    ON s.campaign_id = g.campaign_id
WHERE COALESCE(s.silver_offer_amount, 0) != COALESCE(g.gold_offer_amount, 0)
